title: Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16
description: Corsair's Vengeance LPX is the best-selling DDR4 kit in history: 2x8 GB at 3200 MT/s, CL16, running at 1.35 V via XMP. The low-profile heat spreader clears large CPU coolers, and compatibility is near-universal on DDR4 boards. It is the default recommendation for any DDR4 gaming or office build.
provenance: Manufacturer specifications published by Corsair; DDR generation, speed, and timings are public product data.
demo:
# Memory bandwidth + latency estimator for Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16
MT_S = 3200
BUS_BITS = 128
CL = 16
gbps = MT_S * BUS_BITS / 8 / 1000
cas_ns = CL * 2000.0 / MT_S
print('Kit: Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16')
print('Peak theoretical bandwidth: %.1f GB/s' % gbps)
print('True CAS latency: %.1f ns' % cas_ns)
print('Note: real-world throughput is ~70-85% of peak on dual-channel desktop boards.')
if gbps >= 45:
    print('Verdict: plenty of bandwidth for gaming + integrated-GPU workloads.')
else:
    print('Verdict: fine for office builds; consider a faster kit for gaming.')
